newsitem.title: USA: Illinois hopes 930 MW nuke up in December.
newsitem.headline: Illinois hopes 930 MW nuke up in December.

text.p: Illinois Power Co is hoping to have its 930 megawatt (MW) Clinton nuclear power plant back on line in December following a maintenance and refueling outage, a company spokesman said Tuesday.
"We hope to have it on line by Christmas, but from the onset (of the outage) we really have not set a specific date for a restart," company spokesman John Dewey said.
The Clinton, Ill., plant was taken off line Sept 6 for scheduled maintenance, with rough original expectations of keeping the unit down for about 50 days to Nov 30.
Illinois Power is a subsidiary of Illinova Corp.
